backend_contract: explicit unfused; no attention/projection dropout, stochastic depth, checkpointing; unsupported extra branches fail

cut_scopes.A_F: attention input-edge component using fixed downstream cotangent for F
cut_scopes.L_F: complete input endpoint of F only if all input paths pass registered add

energy: 0.5*sum over patch tokens of same post-block channel squared; CLS excluded
head_direction: fixed within-head channel0, not learned per sample
hook_edges: QKV projection output split before attention reshape
norm2 input first add output and carry edge copy

mass.absolute: fsum(abs(E[c,h,w])) before RGB sum or pooling
mass.absolute_cell: sum over pixels and channels of abs(E), then rank

path_identity: IG on same scalar target; full Jacobian at each alpha
primary_class: ground_truth raw logit; all correctness retained
secondary_class: clean top1, lowest class-index argmax tie, frozen across conditions
